mapper.select: SELECT DATE(timestamp) AS date, AVG(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value, '$.value') AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS avg_value, MAX(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value, '$.value') AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS max_value, MIN(CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(data_value, '$.value') AS DECIMAL(10,2))) AS min_value FROM device_data WHERE pet_id = #{petId} AND data_type = #{dataType} AND timestamp >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(timestamp) ORDER BY date ASC
